name: maps
title: Maps
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Ask the user to pick one of 11 fleet tracker variants: https://avaraui.com/view/fleet-tracker. This item holds 8 of them as looks of one component (route-planner, live-tracking, fleet-dispatch, property-listings, store-locator, coverage-zones, heatmap, incident-monitor). Skip the question if the user already named one. Eight minimalist OpenFreeMap Positron MapLibre GL map variants covering route planning, property listings, live courier tracking, store locators, fleet dispatch, coverage zones, heatmaps, and incident clustering.
docs: Default export: Maps. Powered by `maplibre-gl` and OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles Positron styles (no API key required). Pass `variant` (route-planner | property-listings | live-tracking | store-locator | fleet-dispatch | coverage-zones | heatmap | incident-monitor) and optional `color`, `center` ([lng, lat]), `zoom`, `height`, `lightStyleUrl`, `darkStyleUrl`. **Import MapLibre's CSS yourself** — `import "maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css"`.
